articles.title: Kraken parent Payward's Q1 revenue climbs despite crypto market slump
articles.snippet: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi said the firm kept investing through market weakness, leaning on acquisitions and futures growth to offset softer spot trading.

articles.title: Tokenization push could pull trillions of dollars into DeFi, StanChart says
articles.snippet: The bank projects $4 trillion of tokenized assets by 2028, boosting demand for blockchain-native lending and trading infrastructure.

articles.title: AFX launches sovereign Layer 1, providing an optimized execution environment for on-chain perp DEXes
articles.snippet: AFX, a sovereign Layer 1 purpose-built for decentralized derivatives trading, has officially commenced the operation of its L1 Mainnet, signaling a definitive end to the era of trade execution compromised by general-purpose blockchain congestion.

articles.title: Polymarket Users Spur Insider Trading Suspicions With $2.4 Million in Iran Prediction Wins
articles.snippet: Interlinked Polymarket accounts have made millions betting on U.S. military actions in Iran—and won 98% of the time, analysts say.

articles.title: THORChain’s RUNE Token Plunges Double Digits After $10M Exploit, Trading Halt
articles.snippet: The liquidity protocol halted operations after blockchain researchers identified a suspected $10 million breach across multiple networks.
